title: い-Adjective く します
shortExplanation: Use an い-adjective to express 'to make' or 'to become'.
longExplanation: By adding くします to an い-adjective, you express making something (or causing something to become) the quality of that adjective. In English, this often corresponds to phrases like 'make something more ADJECTIVE.'
formation: い-Adjective (remove い, add く) + します

examples.en: I will make the room brighter.

examples.jp: 友達の気分を楽しくします。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi no kibun o tanoshiku shimasu.
examples.en: I will make my friend’s mood more pleasant.

examples.jp: 仕事が簡単になるように、やり方を早くします。
examples.romaji: Shigoto ga kantan ni naru you ni, yarikata o hayaku shimasu.
examples.en: I will make the way of doing things faster so that the work becomes easier.

examples.jp: 食べ物を美味しくします。
examples.en: I will make the food delicious.
